items.description: Greener pastures ranks U.S. cities based on the greenness of their available housing stock. In a graph, each line represent a city's greenness over time. You can hover over a line to see which city it represents and compare.
Track FedEx packages--with per-segment CO2 estimates.

UBI Voice Assistant is a platform that integrates voice interaction with Internet of Things products, and features Alexa Voice Service (AVS) integration, voice interaction testing, and quality of service monitoring. This platform uses the Maluuba Natural Language API to add natural voice recognition and machine learning capabilities. UCIC (Unified Computer Intelligence Corporation) is an IT firm based in Toronto, Canada.

Frucall is a free phone-based price-comparison shopping service for consumers to compare prices and purchase products using their cell phones, anywhere, anytime. Frucall blends the benefits of in-store shopping with the flexible nature of shopping online.
This tool searches Flickr to count sightings of Monarch Butterflies and display the results on Google Maps. It helps visualize the increase/decrease year over year.
A mashup of Google Maps and Flickr's hosted videos.
iPhone Web App to locate your Facebook friends on a Google map.
A Mac OS X desktop application that lets you browse your del.icio.us accounts.

Exposes the twitter timeline RSS feed via a private link. This helps to tackle problems with the recently enforced Oauth mechanism. Makes use of the feed in other mashups or e.g. archiving in RSS readers possible.
An integration that allows users to send files from their Box.net accounts directly into ConceptShare, where other users can discuss them and offer feedback in a real-time setting.
Displays satellite images of all 2009 Formula One Grand Prix Circuits with race results and grand prix information.
Choose a destination city, arrival, and departure date and view your choices in a map overlay of the city.
Convert HTML5 code and CSS to images online.
A unique Twitter Game of Brazilian Football Championship.
A collaborative way to plan, coordinate, and share gatherings that involve travel.
Ever wanted to see all your Google Contacts on a map? With the Google Contacts Map you can easily do so.
allSongsBy provides full song listings for any artist via YouTube's vast free music collection. Lists are organized by artist and album.
Perspecives of British landscape: images and text from cities and towns around Britain.
Twoogle is a twitter search that allows you to search Twitter by geo location instant live search, ipad iphone android. Also build a Twitter collage from a choosen key word, have fun and share.

Time tracking, inventory and resource management from your phone. Time Keeper and Inventory Tracker updates by SMS or web. Barcode generator; scan and text to update. Project Management integration. SMS requires a Twilio account.
The largest and most comprehensive listing of telephone answering companies in the UK.

This uses Mera Caar API hosted on Heroku and has its specification on Programmable Web at https://www.programmableweb.com/api/mera-caar. It uses the API for the very purpose the API was created in the first place - to guide the viewer about the components present inside a generic car.
